sql: SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / CAST(anglers AS FLOAT)) as yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) as day_count, SUM(CAST(yt AS INT)) as total_yt FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 305 GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC LIMIT 50
